paragraphs: Interface design; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Figma, rebuilt in pure Rust.
Frames, auto layout, components and variants, vector networks, styles, variables and prototypes,
in a native app that opens instantly and works offline. Open source, and yours.
features: Auto layout in both directions, with wrap and grid (fixed, hug and fr tracks, cells that span), padding, gaps, alignment including text baselines, Hug / Fill / Fixed sizing, min and max sizes, absolute positioning, drag…

Main components, instances with overrides that survive edits, component sets with variants, properties, swap instance, detach, reset overrides and go to main component, and an Assets panel with live thumbnails, search…

Real vector networks: the Pen and Pencil tools, vector edit mode with its own tools (pen that extends and branches paths, bend, paint bucket fills for any closed area, lasso, cut), point panel with handle mirroring and…

Solid, linear, radial, angular and diamond gradients with on-canvas handles, image fills (fill, fit, crop, tile) with adjustments and presets, multiple fills and strokes, every blend mode, drop and inner shadows (spread…

Text edited in place on the canvas (with inline IME composition), mixed styles within a paragraph, auto width and auto height, line height, letter and paragraph spacing, decoration, case, lists, OpenType features,…

whatItDoes.text: Interface design; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Figma, rebuilt in pure Rust.

requirements.text: No account, no telemetry, and nothing leaves your computer unless you share a file (what sharing sends where).
No accounts yet: links are the access.

Nearly all of Figma's main menu is wired (docs/parity-checklist.md) and the core editor works end to end, but FigCraft opens .fig files only best effort, has only a first preview of multiplayer (live sessions hosted from the app or a self-hosted server, with per-person undo and share links to edit or to view; no accounts, teams or cloud yet), runs its own WebAssembly plugins…
